verdicts.title: Product Ranks of the $3\times 3$ Determinant and Permanent
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show that the product rank of the $3\times 3$ determinant is $5$, and the product rank of the $3\times 3$ permanent is $4$. As a corollary, we obtain that the tensor ranks of the $3 \times 3$ determinant and permanent are $5$ and $4$, respectively. We show moreover that the border product rank of the $n \times n$ permanent is larger than $n$ for any $n\geq 3$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns product/tensor ranks of the 3x3 determinant and permanent polynomials, not q-Mahonian (major index) cancellation ratios on 0/1-support matrices. It shares only the 'determinant vs permanent' vocabulary without touching the specific q=2 cancellation bound.

verdicts.title: The determinant of the Malliavin matrix and the determinant of the covariance matrix for multiple integrals
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A well-known problem in Malliavin calculus concerns the relation between the determinant of the Malliavin matrix of a random vector and the determinant of its covariance matrix. We give an explicit relation between these two determinants for couples of random vectors of multiple integrals.
